flags.note: Only the vector ranking is shown for the default question; keyword/hybrid tables and their scores aren't visible in the static shot, and the keyword list isn't explained, so the 1/61 + 1/63 terms can't be checked.
'ANN' and 'region' grouping are introduced fine, but the 16-region grid squares are never said to be fixed partitions until Go deeper; minor.
G2 is ranked worse (#2) yet in top 2 so row is orange; the ↓ worse row gets same highlight as better rows, so regression isn't visually marked.

visuals.S01: 2D vector plot of river, flooded, collapsed, closed, account from origin (water axis up, money axis right) plus orange bars of cosine similarity with river (1.00, 0.99, 0.61, 0.12).
visuals.S02: Slider for docs size (50,000 tokens) with four stat cards: fits in 128K, $0.150 per question pasting all, $0.0030 with 3 passages, 50x more tokens.
visuals.S03: Two multiple-choice pre-questions shown as option chips: what a model does closed-book, and how to verify retrieval after changes.
visuals.S04: Toggle question-only vs question+C2; orange bars show next-token probabilities for numbers 60/100/1,000/10 (30/26/24/20%), rising to 96% for 100 with C2.
visuals.S05: k slider with ranked table of 8 passages C1-C8 by cosine (0.86 down to 0.17), orange row = retrieved, star = answer-holding; shows augmented prompt and wrong answer 10 from C3 at k=1.
visuals.S06: Chunk-size (6/12/24/48 words) and overlap toggles over the rate-limit text split into chunks; star marks chunk with 100; cards show whether /search stays with 100 and topics per chunk.
visuals.S07: Sliders for docs size and edits per week above a comparison table of long context, RAG, fine-tuning across tokens/question, edit latency, source citing; chosen row bold.
visuals.S08: Lollipop chart with one row per passage C1-C8, x axis cosine similarity 0-1, orange filled = top 3 retrieved, star = answer; question tabs above and ranked table below.
visuals.S09: Question and method (keyword/vector/hybrid) toggles over the ranked passage table; orange rows = top 2 retrieved, star = answer passage ranked #2 under vector.
visuals.S10: 16-region grid of ~400 grey dots, teal dot = question, shaded squares = checked regions, ringed = true 5 nearest, orange = found; cards show 25 of 400 compared and 20% recall.
visuals.S11: Question toggle and score-floor slider (0.50) over ranked table; orange rows retrieved above floor, lower rows labelled below floor; result line says bot answered 100 right.

visuals.S14: Grader toggle (exact match/LLM judge/+rubric) over five bot answers with human label, grader label, agrees (green)/disagrees (red); card shows 3/5=60% agreement.
